name: dsh-smart-websearch
description: Smart web search + fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness. Reuses the built-in web_search/web_fetch tools and makes them faster, more reliable, and less wasteful: language-aware routing (Chinese queries direct via cn.bing/Baidu, overseas via proxy), multi-engine hedged fallback, result caching, domestic-direct/overseas-proxy fetching, and search-hygiene nudges to curb redundant searches. An update-proof alternative to patching dsh-free-search.
